subject: Re: PilotPad cohort - request for one-time credits
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@founderslab.org>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Nov 2025 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Request: one-time credits for PilotPad cohort

Hi Marissa,

Hope you’re well — quick ask from PilotPad: we admitted a handful of late teams into our winter cohort and they need extra compute to run live demos during the showcase (early Dec). We budgeted for Redwood credits but the acceptance came after the initial allotment closed.

Is there any possibility of a one-time credit top-up for these 6 teams (~8k total credits) to help them finish their builds and demos? We can provide a short success metric (7 demo apps live, 1 technical write-up per team) and will highlight Redwood in our partner slide. If a one-off is a hard no, we’d consider a staged allocation tied to milestone delivery.

Attached is a roster + short note on expected usage per team. Would appreciate your guidance on whether we can make an exception for this cohort — timing is tight.

Thanks,
Elena Park
Program Director, PilotPad Accelerator
elena@founderslab.org
Attachment: PilotPad_cohort_roster.csv (CSV, 12KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@founderslab.org>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Nov 2025 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: one-time credits for PilotPad cohort

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the roster. Congrats on the late admits — sounds exciting.

Short answer: likely yes, but we need to align internally on how the credits are issued and what conversion/recoup terms (if any) apply. Two practical routes I can propose now:

- One-time promo credits: issue ~8,000 free credits to be used by Dec 15. Straightforward but needs finance pre-authorization.
- Staged allocation: 4k now, 4k on delivery of the demo checklist (your metrics). This reduces the upside risk and gives us publicity on success.

Looping in Ben and Laura to confirm the accounting/approval path. Ben — can you confirm whether Sales can approve a conditional promo + a 10% conversion discount if PilotPad converts to a paid committed plan within 90 days? Laura — can Finance pre-authorize up to $800 of promotional liability for this deal id?

If that sounds okay to you, Elena, I’ll draft a one-page term sheet and send a DocuSign for signature.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference — Developer-first LLM inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Nov 2025 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: one-time credits for PilotPad cohort

Marissa / team — thanks for the context. I’m okay with a conditional exception here given PilotPad’s reach and the short window. Recommended approach:

1) Offer: 8,000 one-time credits, expiring 2025-12-15.
2) Conversion incentive: 10% off first 3 months of Dedicated commit if they sign within 90 days (tracked to deal DL-2025-1182).
3) Publicity: include Redwood logo on cohort showcase materials + short case blurb (we’ll add to partner highlights).

Approval path: Sales OK -> Finance pre-authorize promo liability ($800 cap) -> Legal quick review of the one-pager (standard partner promo language). I’ve attached a draft promo term sheet for review.

Notes: If Finance wants to lower exposure, we can do 4k now / 4k on demo deliverable. Also recommend setting a hard usage cap per team (e.g., 2k each) to prevent one team from consuming all credits.

Attaching: promo_term_sheet.pdf

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Growth, Redwood Inference
Attachment: promo_term_sheet.pdf (PDF, 24KB)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: one-time credits for PilotPad cohort

Thanks for pulling this together. Finance can pre-authorize up to $800 of promotional liability tied to deal DL-2025-1182, provided we have one of the following before credits are pushed:

- Signed DocuSign with the promo term sheet OR
- A PO from PilotPad that references the promo and deal id

Operational notes: we prefer the 4k/4k staged approach so we can invoice/expense against milestones. If Sales prefers the full 8k upfront, Finance needs a short memo from LA (Ben) describing expected ROI and the publicity plan.

Also: set an expiry of 60 days for the promo acceptance window (i.e., credits must start being used within 60 days of the DocuSign date) to avoid open-ended liabilities.

If legal needs to tweak language, loop in LegalOps; otherwise I can sign-off on the finance side once DocuSign/PO is in place.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Park <elena@founderslab.org>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 16:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: one-time credits for PilotPad cohort

Marissa / Ben / Laura — this is great, thank you. PilotPad is happy to accept the staged approach: 4,000 now, 4,000 on delivery of the demo checklist. We’ll also include Redwood in the cohort slide and provide a 150–200 word case blurb after the showcase.

Next steps from our side: I’ll send a PO referencing DL-2025-1182 first thing tomorrow and sign the DocuSign when you send the term sheet.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — timing is tight but doable on our end.

Best,
Elena
Program Director, PilotPad Accelerator
Attachment: PO_pending (will send PDF)
